column1: # Names for TP.exe (Theme Park World v2.0 noCD, image base 0x400000). Applied by
# tools/ghidra/ApplyNames.java of the New Game+ skill, then tools/ghidra/TPWVtables.java; see re/deep-pass.md.
#   address  0x-prefixed hex. One line per address; sorted by address.
#   name     Subsystem_Name for free functions, g_Name for globals, Class::vftable for vtables (this
#            names the class; TPWVtables.java then names its unnamed slots Class::vfXX and makes them
#            __thiscall), Function_What for labels inside a function (patch and call sites).
#   note     what it does. [report] = the re/*.md report that established it; notes without a tag were
#            added in the deep pass and start with a confidence letter (H read from the code, M
#            mechanism clear but purpose inferred, L a guess). "(also: X [report])" records a different
#            name another report gave the same address; the reports may still use those older names.
#   type     a C prototype for functions, or a C type for globals ("int", "GameTimer"; structs are
#            in re/types.tsv). Leave empty unless sure.
# Corrections folded in: 0x0046c0b0 is a CRT static initialiser, not an FPS hotkey, and 0x00729f00
# a static-constructor table (frame-timing.md 9.2 was wrong); the timer object 0x00785970 layout is in
# types.tsv (GameTimer), frame-timing.md 5.1 was partly wrong. Names inside .text that are data
# (c_dfDIMouse 0x00679440, c_dfDIKeyboard 0x0067a460) are left out: ApplyNames would turn them into
